name: TGIF Agribusiness Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2023, TGIF Agribusiness 
Ltd is in the business of open farming of 
fruits and vegetables[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
TGIFAL is a horticulture company engaged in open farming of fruits and vegetables. Its farm land is spread over 110 acres and is situated in the vicinity of three villages i.e. Ajari, Kasindra and Kojra, all of which are located in the tehsil of Pindwara, Rajasthan.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
